title: No prompt injection
description: Scans the text an agent will read (params.fields of the payload, and a skill's or markdown file's text) for prompt injection: attempts to override the agent's guidance, piping downloads into a shell, pointing at credentials, and invisible Unicode tag characters.

fields.description: Payload fields to scan (default title, description)

file.description: Also scan the file's text: { md }, { text } or a text/markdown file (default true)
